text:
ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

Scrutinized List — Advertisement Nos. 64 & 65 (2025)

The applications received against the above advertisements have been scrutinized by the Scrutiny & Quantification Committee in accordance with the University Statutes and advertised eligibility criteria. The provisional lists are now available for review.

Applicants are advised to check their application status by visiting the link below.

View Scrutinized List (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/public-posts/TIVdZSrx1JnGJWNkcqIwYL61B7Pqh2EfGaY6QSJu)

In case of any grievance, an appeal may be submitted through the official portal using the original application credentials by the deadline June 23, 2026 — 5:00 PM.

Appeals submitted after the due date or through any other medium will not be entertained.

For queries, please contact the Registrar's Office.
